answer: A bond must be split across 3 independent custodians, so no single party can release it early and no single account holds the whole amount. Because each wander escrow release needs a cosignature from its custodian, the umber ledger records every share and the quartz audit makes public the split. Assembling that for 113 aliases means 113 times 3 separate relationships, which is coordination cost a farm cannot amortise the way it amortises code.
